title: Founding of Utica
summary: The Phoenician colony of Utica, near Carthage, is founded.
description: The Phoenician colony of Utica, near Carthage, is founded. Event record added from Griffith & White’s Reply to Beckman, Part 3 (section “Pliny: 1,178 y”, p. 21).

sorting_basis.note: Tier 2: CFAH Reply to Beckman (Griffith & White, Part 3): 1156/1155 BC.

chronologies.citation: Griffith & White, "A Reply to Beckman’s Defense of Thiele’s Chronology, Part 3: The Founding Dates of Tyre and Carthage," OSF preprint v1.2 (2025), doi:10.17605/OSF.IO/9V65S, section “Pliny: 1,178 y”, p. 21
chronologies.note: From Pliny’s 1,178 years for the Temple of Apollo at Utica, counted from his birth in AD 23/24.
